# shopify-support-chat

> A Brevo Conversations chat bubble for the admin side of a Shopify app: merchants message the app developer from inside the embedded app, and each conversation is tagged with the shop, the merchant and the app. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM, MIT. Install a release tag tarball, never a branch. Admin pages only, never a storefront. Visitor identity is unverified by design. The visitor is one flat object of scalar properties (email, firstName, lastName, notes, SHOP, MERCHANT, APP, IDENTITY). lastName is the app and notes is "<shop> · UNVERIFIED…": standard Brevo fields shown in every account; the custom keys show only if the Brevo account has contact attributes with those names, as Brevo's updateIntegrationData requires. Pass a visitorId (derived on the server with supportChatVisitorId from the ./server entry, an HMAC of the app and the shop under a server-only secret) so each app + store gets its own Brevo conversation instead of one anonymous visitor shared across the Shopify admin; never compute it in the browser. Before the widget starts, the package clears Shopify's launch credentials (id_token, hmac, session, timestamp and any JWT-shaped value) from the page address with history.replaceState, because the widget reports the address to its vendor; if it cannot, nothing loads. Never build a link by copying the current query string: the router still holds the launch URL.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/01ecommerce/shopify-support-chat/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, options, CSP, privacy
